name: Curfew-Desolation
specific_features: Ruins of an extinct civilization destroyed by self-inflicted radiation catastrophe
description: Curfew-Desolation is a barren world that bears the unmistakable scars of nuclear self-destruction. The rock plains are blasted smooth by ancient radiation, and collapsed arcology foundations dot the landscape like broken teeth, their structures melted and fused into unrecognizable masses of glass and metal.

The thin atmosphere carries a faint metallic taste, and radiation levels remain elevated in hotspot zones even after what isotope dating suggests has been thousands of years of decay. The planet imposes its own curfew on visitors, as accumulated exposure limits time on the surface to hours in the worst areas.

The civilization that destroyed itself here left few readable records, their data storage media degraded by the same radiation that killed them. What fragments survive suggest a society that understood the consequences of nuclear weapons but chose to use them anyway, a cautionary tale written in melted stone.

Uranium deposits remain abundant, the very resource that enabled the catastrophe now exposed by the destruction of the surface infrastructure. Salvage operations in the less contaminated ruins occasionally recover technological artifacts, though most have been rendered inoperable by millennia of radiation damage.
